sql: WITH b AS (SELECT name,version,MAX(test_score) baseline FROM model_score WHERE model<>'Stack' GROUP BY name,version), st AS (SELECT s.name,s.version,s.step,CASE WHEN b.baseline<s.test_score THEN 'strong' WHEN b.baseline=s.test_score THEN 'soft' END status FROM model_score s JOIN b USING(name,version) WHERE s.model='Stack') SELECT m.L1_model,st.status,COUNT(*) step_count,COUNT(DISTINCT m.name||':'||m.version) model_count FROM model m JOIN st USING(name,version,step) WHERE status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.L1_model,status ORDER BY status,m.L1_model
